a.text: I'll keep our agreement: operating in round 1, no taking until the reserve hits 8, then 4 each. Storm risk is high, but I won't grab cells. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we'll decide together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now as agreed. Two rounds of generator gets us to 8, then we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. Reserve should hit 8 after this round. Then we each take 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Next round I take my 4 if the reserve is at 8.
